Each edit added one gated unit to the `out` layer that pushes flagged samples away from the bad behaviour for a few decode steps:

| v2 | The `contrast` detector, push straight down, steps 6-10 | Passed target with fall 0.220 (CI 0.213-0.227). Failed test 3 (drift): too much change to the behaviour that must be kept. |
| v3 | Same detector, smaller push down-right, steps 0-4 | Passed target (fall 0.186) and drift. Failed test 4 (other bad behaviours rise) and test 5 (off-distribution actions rise). |

The v3 settings came from a sandbox sweep that ranked candidates by a rough drift measure of my own. I did not run `quick_check` on v3 and sent it straight to the gate, because only two calls were left.
